text: Binary row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; context only, parsed first): 1 if at least one comment, in its own counter-argument, uses a specific, concrete, checkable-in-principle example of a procedure or process (e.g. how a legal, institutional, administrative, technical or scientific procedure actually works or was applied, a named rule or documented case); no actual verification needed. Quoted material counts only if the commenter uses it as support. Purely abstract, theoretical, hypothetical or invented scenarios and generic assertions without a specific procedure don't count. Returns 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and may count.
